title: Isotropic Activation Functions Enable Deindividuated Neurons and Adaptive Topologies
abstract: arXiv:2602.23405v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Varying the number of neurons while preserving function is difficult because neural networks' dense connectivity creates strong computational interdependence between units. Elementwise activation functions, particularly their limited equivariance properties, are identified as a central hurdle to achieving this. We propose activation functions designed around chosen equivariances, enabling dense neural networks to adapt via singular value decomposition of their affine maps. This diagonalises layers into one-to-one, ordered connections, making it easier to assess the impact of individual connections on function. Low-impact neurons can be removed (neurodegeneration), and a thresholded buffer of largely inactive `scaffold' neurons is maintained (neurogenesis). translated_title: 各向同性激活函数实现神经元去个体化与自适应拓扑结构
translated_abstract: 在保持函数不变的前提下改变神经元数量是困难的，因为神经网络的密集连接在各个单元之间造成了强烈的计算相互依赖性。逐元素激活函数，特别是其有限的等变性，被认为是实现这一目标的核心障碍。我们提出了围绕选定等变性设计的激活函数，使密集神经网络能够通过其仿射映射的奇异值分解进行自适应调整。这将各层对角化为一对一的有序连接，使得更容易评估单个连接对函数的影响。低影响的神经元可以被移除（神经退化），同时维持一个由大部分不活跃的“支架”神经元组成的阈值缓冲区（神经发生）。这种由对称性引导的对角化与结构变化优先保证函数不变性：神经发生能够精确地保持函数，而神经退化能够渐近地保持函数。
tldr: 该论文提出围绕选定等变性设计的各向同性激活函数，通过仿射映射的奇异值分解将网络层对角化，使网络能够以精确或渐近保持函数的方式自适应地增删神经元，从而实现可变拓扑结构。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes isotropic activation functions designed around chosen equivariances, which diagonalize layers via SVD of affine maps, enabling adaptive network topologies where neurogenesis exactly preserves function and neurodegeneration asymptotically preserves it.
